name: AppLovin Conversions API
description: Send Segment events to the AppLovin Conversions API.

pixel_id.label: Event Key
pixel_id.description: Your AppLovin Event Key, found in the AppLovin Ads Manager under Keys. AppLovin's API documentation calls this the pixel ID, but it is the same value.

api_key.label: Conversion API Key
api_key.description: Your AppLovin Conversion API key. Create one on the API keys page of the AppLovin Ads Manager.

sendEvent.title: Send Event
sendEvent.description: Send an event to the AppLovin Conversions API.

event_time.label: Event Time
event_time.description: When the event occurred. Must be in ISO 8601 format. Segment converts it to a Unix timestamp in milliseconds before sending to AppLovin.

event_source_url.label: Event Source URL
event_source_url.description: The full URL of the page where the event occurred. Include it for web events, including events sent server-side. It can be omitted for app events.

dedupe_id.label: Dedupe ID
dedupe_id.description: A unique ID for this event. AppLovin uses it to de-duplicate this event against the same event sent by the AppLovin Pixel, so it must match the dedupe ID on the Pixel event for the same conversion.

user_data.label: User Data
user_data.description: User and device details used by AppLovin to match the event to a user. Required: ALEID, IP Address, User Agent, Event Source, and at least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID. All other fields are optional. Email and phone are normalized and SHA-256 hashed before sending. ALEID, ALART and AXWRT are populated automatically by the AppLovin Conversions API Plugins destination.

aleid.label: ALEID
aleid.description: Required. The aleid query parameter that AppLovin adds to your website URL after a user clicks an ad. Also stored in the _axeid cookie.

client_ip_address.label: IP Address
client_ip_address.description: Required. The public IP address of the user. IPv4 is preferred.

client_user_agent.label: User Agent
client_user_agent.description: Required. The user agent of the browser or device.

esi.label: Event Source
esi.description: Required. Where the event came from.

alart.label: ALART
alart.description: The alart query parameter that AppLovin adds to your URL after an ad click, used to attribute app users. Also stored in the _axart cookie. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

axwrt.label: AXWRT
axwrt.description: The axwrt value set by the AppLovin Pixel, stored in the _axwrt cookie. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: A stable first-party identifier for the user. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

email.label: Email
email.description: The user's email address. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: The user's phone number, including the country code. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: Your unique customer identifier. Must be at least 6 characters. Shorter values are ignored. At least one of ALART, AXWRT, Client ID, Email, Phone or User ID is required.

ifa.label: Advertising ID
ifa.description: The IDFA or GAID of the device.

os.label: Operating System
os.description: The operating system of the device. Accepted values are ios, android, macos, windows and desktop_os. Segment values such as iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS and Windows are converted automatically (case-insensitive); anything else is sent as desktop_os.

us_zip.label: US ZIP
us_zip.description: The billing ZIP code for US users. Only the first 5 characters are sent. If both US ZIP and Non US ZIP are provided, US ZIP is used.

non_us_zip.label: Non US ZIP
non_us_zip.description: The billing postal code for users outside the US. Sent as provided.

items.label: Items
items.description: The products involved in the event. Quantity is required for add_to_cart, remove_from_cart and purchase events.

item_variant_id.label: Item Variant ID
item_variant_id.description: A unique ID for the variant of the item, such as a size or color.

item_category_id.label: Item Category ID
item_category_id.description: The numeric category ID from AppLovin's supported category list, for example 1 for Animals & Pet Supplies. Must be an integer, not a category name. See the full list: https://support.applovin.com/en/growth/promoting-your-websites/track-and-optimize/events-and-objects#category-ids

image_url.label: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of an image of the item, ending in .png, .jpg or .jpeg.

price.label: Price
price.description: The unit price of the item. Use the discounted price if a discount applies.

discount.label: Discount
discount.description: The discount applied to a single unit.

affiliation.label: Affiliation
affiliation.description: The supplier, company or store associated with the item.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD. Required for begin_checkout, purchase and generate_lead.

value.label: Value
value.description: The monetary value of the event. For purchase this is the subtotal before tax and shipping. Required for begin_checkout, purchase and generate_lead.

transaction_id.label: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: The unique ID of the transaction.

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.description: The shipping cost. Use 0 if there is none.

tax.label: Tax
tax.description: The tax amount. Use 0 if there is none.

is_new_customer.label: Is New Customer
is_new_customer.description: Whether the customer is new. Only send if you are not using the AppLovin Shopify app or uploading order history data.

search_term.label: Search Term
search_term.description: The term the user searched for.

enable_batching.label: Batch Data
enable_batching.description: When enabled, Segment sends events to AppLovin in batches.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Maximum number of events to include in each batch. AppLovin accepts up to 100 per request.

presets.name: AppLovin Browser Plugin
presets.subscribe: type = "track" or type = "identify" or type = "group" or type = "page" or type = "alias"
